SCENE: Petra's House, morning
A small blue cottage with a red door. Sunflowers nod in the breeze.
ON SCREEN: Petra (yellow raincoat)
PETRA (happy): Today I will find the soother.
CG: The soother spinning in the sky above the garden
PETRA (worried): The soother is gone again.
SFX: A tiny bell chimes
AMBIENCE: Wind in the sunflowers
PETRA: I will follow it.
